It runs as a Kubernetes service consisting of an Endpoint Picker (EPP) process that integrates with Envoy via the ext-proc protocol to make intelligent request placement decisions based on KV-cache locality, load, and priority. It also includes a disaggregation sidecar for coordinating multi-stage inference (prefill/decode). While it defines two CRDs (InferenceObjective, InferenceModelRewrite) and uses controller-runtime, its primary purpose is request routing rather than Kubernetes resource lifecycle management, making it a service rather than an operator.
